title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Twisted
overview: As the heir to her parents’ legendary pizzeria, Angelina, a feisty Italian teenager, fears breaking tradition might break their hearts. As her desire to break free grows, so do her lies. But when her web of deceit spins out of control, she opens a portal to a wondrous and treacherous mythical underworld putting her family in grave danger. To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.

title: Get to That Place
overview: A group of kids navigate their lives and interpersonal relationships while a rumor about the end of the world spreads around town.

title: Classified
overview: "I can’t put words to you, I can’t put labels to you; but what I can put are a whole ton of emotions and feelings to you, and even then I can’t put words to those."

title: Prodigal Son
overview: Aaron "Amadeus" Overlake is a visionary filmmaker revered for his genius but plagued by his own demons—a volatile alcoholic whose life is consumed by anger, controversy, and from a bitter heartbreak. As tabloids revel in his self-destruction, Aaron’s only anchor is his best friend, Santiago "Baron" Gonzalez, a charismatic actor fresh out of rehab, fighting to rebuild his career.  Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: Christmas at the Zoo
overview: An entrepreneur brokering a sponsorship to build the city zoo's new penguin habitat finds herself caught between business and romance after falling for a compassionate zookeeper over the holidays.

title: Malvina
overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

title: 109 Billion Followers
overview: A lonely film student documents a man who believes that he’s the Grim Reaper, as he leads her on a magical journey to meet herself as a teen, as a young girl, and as an infant, to recover her ability to love – while she still can.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by Georges Perec’s A Man Asleep, the film examines contemporary alienation in a today’s emotionally numbed world of hyperconnectivity and endless information.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Kiwi Food
overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

title: The Quiet Hour
overview: "The Quiet Hour" is a gripping, intimate drama set over the course of one relentless night shift in an NHS hospital, where overworked nurse Riya battles exhaustion, guilt, and the ghosts of past mistakes while caring for her patients. As she juggles a collapsing system, an understaffed ward, and a stream of emergencies—from dying patients to Fred, a combative amputee, and a medical error that nearly costs a life—her professional composure begins to fracture. Haunted by the memory of a young girl she couldn’t save and the growing distance from her teenage daughter, Riya’s night spirals into a raw reckoning with compassion, burnout, and the quiet heroism that holds the health service together.

title: 3 Days Rising
overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

title: Trevor Lies
overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

title: Hazard Perception
overview: An expectant father and a woman haunted by her fear of driving spark an unexpected connection while waiting to be called in for their driving test.

title: Perfect Imperfection
overview: A conversation between a uni-bound student and his mentor. Exploring themes of voice and vulnerability.

title: You're Late
overview: YOU'RE LATE is an independent short film written, directed, and produced by Neeraj Patel and Grey Silhouette Films

title: Adam’s Fire
overview: In the misty mountains of West Virginia, a grieving young boy who has lost all hope finds an unexpected friendship, a chance to heal, and the breathtaking power of forgiveness.

title: Choice
overview: A rookie police detective is forced to make a decision that will effect his life and his career...

title: The First Silence
overview: A gaslit woman battles with her memory of events.

title: The Undiscovered Country
overview: In the wake of a college student's unexplained disappearance, her classmates struggle to make sense of her absence, a mosaic of overlapping memories, fragmented conversations, and shifting perspectives begins to reveal the complex truths they have concealed from one another, and from themselves.

title: ADHD
overview: Clara, a neurodiverse, overwhelmed corporate employee, struggles to manage her workload and the number of daily tasks she has to keep up with just to stay alive in the modern world, within a sterile corporate environment. After being summoned to a meeting with her manager and HR, she deflects criticism of her work and inappropriate behaviour by blaming everything on her ADHD.

title: Behind the Reflection
overview: A woman struggles with their identity, leading to a life of addiction, alcoholism and violence. A gritty drama based on the true life of Rozelle Gemma.

title: Trash Magnet
overview: An egotistical artist steals a lost watch for their project, and becomes trapped in a time loop that forces them to confront the real-world cost of their self-absorption.

title: Procedure
overview: In 1976, Elaine Carter, a closeted police officer, is assigned to escort Thomas Avery, a whistleblower whose actions saved the life of the woman she loves. Confined together mid-flight, Elaine is forced to confront the strict procedure that has defined her career, and the personal cost of finally breaking it.

title: Crocodile Tears
overview: Hired to pose as a dead boy's girlfriend, a professional mourner finds her hardest act is keeping herself from falling apart.

title: Eyes
overview: A team of mental health professionals joins hands with the police force to tackle the surge in stalker killings. While trying to predict and prevent such incidents, they navigate the complex minds of stalkers and the emotional webs they weave.

title: Blade
overview: Sophie, a vulnerable teenage girl caught in a cycle of emotional validation and humiliation by a boy who objectifies her, blurs the line between fantasy and reality as her longing for affection begins to consume her sense of self.

title: The Talking Stage
overview: Homecoming is approaching, and Xander still doesn't have a date. The Plan: Have Xander walk around campus with a sign and ask everyone at the school to be his date.

title: Mayookha
overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

title: Closing Time
overview: "Closing Time"  sees Mo, a gifted but undocumented migrant working in his uncle’s kebab shop, keep his culinary ambitions hidden until he meets Laila, a thoughtful lawyer trapped in a stagnant engagement. Their connection grows over late-night conversations and cooking sessions, where Laila encourages Mo to pursue his dreams and he gently challenges her to confront the life she’s settled for.

title: Graduate syndrome Deluxe Version
overview: The bayos horses came with a continuation of the winner grammy of the best high school album

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: Semicolon
overview: Two old friends reconnect after the unexpected death of their best friend.

title: Where No One Can Find Her
original_title: Where No One Can Find Her
overview: When her teen daughter Izzy is kidnapped and buried alive, Jamie and her ex-husband must put aside their differences and work together to raise a massive ransom and save Izzy from a premature grave.

title: SIKLAB
overview: When a college student's secret double life as a masked vigilante is discovered by his oldest friend, the two must navigate their evolving bond and the sudden dangers closing in around them.

title: To Catch a Stepfather
overview: After the death of her husband, Allison Simon finds love again with charming businessman Roger, but her son Eric quickly senses something sinister beneath his new stepfather's perfect facade.

title: Four Days In June
overview: A Midwest arts festival brings 60,000 people together for four days of music, food, and creativity, revealing how shared experiences can create rare common ground in a divided world.

title: Somethin' Stupid
overview: When Brynn discovers hat her ex-boyfriend will be living next door for another semester, she must muster the courage to tell him how she really feels.

title: Stream of Terror
overview: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

title: Reform Zara
overview: John Galliano’s process of reworking garments for Zara unfolds alongside theatrical tableaux suspended between past and future. Intimate conversations and observations of dressmaking reveal how a pocket alters posture, an opening changes movement, and clothing becomes character. Moving between documentary and fiction, the film explores imagination, memory and authorship through the transformation of familiar forms.

title: The Leftovers
overview: Four longtime friends, once a group of eight called the Clique,  recall the stories of their strong friendship side by side for the past 46 years, while also navigating the struggles of the loss of their spouses and best friends - proving that companionship is not only a comfort but a form of medicine against  loneliness and grief.

title: Spiral
overview: While celebrating his engagement, Sean finds out that his future brother-in-law has an unnaturally large penis.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: The Blue Sea
overview: A fisherman has the impression that he is rotting from the inside, like one of his teeth that is bothering him. Lost in the maze of his painful memories, frustrated by the sense of disorder that surrounds him, he is helpless in the face of the spectacle of the repressed demonstrators he sees every day on television. His depression causes his body to melt in an abstract way and to disperse in trails of droplets, in the manner of Francis Bacon's portraits.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: For Deer Life
overview: Beneath the beauty of spring lies a brutal tragedy… The birth of roe deer fawns coincides with the mowing season in Austria’s meadows, leading to a brutal struggle between nature and modern agriculture. “For Deer Life” tells the story of the dedicated drone operators, who put their heart and soul into rescuing the lives of as many fawns as possible. The film highlights the powerful combination of innovative use of thermal drones and the unwavering commitment of volunteers, to prevent this tragic loss of life. With the aim to inspire both a local and global audience to embrace technology as a conservation means, emphasising the harmonious balance between agriculture and wildlife protection.

title: Pen to Paper
overview: A young man struggles to write a legible, heartfelt letter to his mum by hand.

title: Bruton
overview: A tragic accident leads Bryan Bruton on a wild and unforgettable experience within the Florida prison system.

title: Epitaph
overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

title: Until You're Alone
overview: After becoming the lead suspect in a series of brutal slayings, a close-minded architect must team up with a free-spirited sex worker in order to clear his name and solve the crimes before they become the killer's next victims in this suspenseful, stylish, and hilarious queer love letter to Hitchcock, De Palma, and the Italian giallo.

title: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
overview: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: EPISODE 12
overview: On June 6th 2023 television show Paranormal Closure was pulled from all broadcast stations. With no statement as to why. Over a year later a video surfaced online claiming to be from the episode that never aired.

title: Scotty
overview: A stray cat (Scotty) has to travel with a pet cat (Katie) despite his desire to return to his territory, but when he gets home, he realizes that living with those he loves is better than living alone.

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: Amy Winehouse: The Tragic Downfall
overview: A documentary that delves into the life, career, and struggles of iconic British singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse. Through the archival footage, interviews with those who knew her and expert analysis, the film explores Amy's quick rise to fame, her battles with addiction and mental health issues, and the pressure of celebrity culture. It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

title: If You Can Make It Here
original_title: If You Can Make It Here
overview: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: The Legend of Yella George
overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.
